text:
karina (Docs): Heads-up — opened PR for 'budgeted rate cap' examples in the pricing / rate-limits doc. need quick review on wording and the SDK snippet.

michael (Pricing): Thanks. Did you add the per-tenant burst-credit example? we should show both v1 and v2 header shapes.

karina (Docs): yes — added a short table + two snippet blocks. The table uses "budgeted_rate" and "burst_allowance" columns. Is that naming ok? cc @michael (Pricing)

michael (Pricing): names are fine. prefer `burst_allowance` to avoid conflict with the billing term "burst credits". maybe add a note about billing delays: usage may appear ~1m delayed in billing UI.

cj (Eng): Quick ask — the v2 SDK header example currently uses `X-Redwood-RateCap: budgeted=100,burst=20`. SDK's header parser expects `budgeted_rate=100;burst_allowance=20`. can we converge?

oliver (SDK): ah sorry, our doc was out of sync. I'll paste the exact v2 examples we support:

oliver (SDK): ```http
# curl example for v2
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v2/complete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Budgeted-Rate: 100" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Burst-Allowance: 20" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-l1","prompt":"..."}'
```

dana (PM): Can we also add a short sentence about dashboard mapping? e.g., how budgeted_rate -> panel 'Reserved RPS' and burst_allowance -> 'Burst capacity'. product team gets frantic if names diverge.

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch docs/pr-budgeted-ratecap-examples — CI: docs-lint, snippet-tests

karina (Docs): Updated PR with the curl block and a brief note linking to the dashboard panel: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage#rate-limits (short link — please double-check)

cj (Eng): the snippet-tests failed on header parsing in CI; oliver can you push a small fix to the test harness to accept both header casing variants? otherwise docs CI will keep flaking.

oliver (SDK): yep will add a case-insensitive header matcher to the test harness in next minute. also pushing a follow-up PR to normalize header keys in examples.

michael (Pricing): LGTM from pricing side once the wording about billing delay is added. also add a one-line callout about quota enforcement tiers (free / team / enterprise) and how budgeted rates map to those tiers.

karina (Docs): added the callout, clarified delay note, and updated the table naming. ready for final review. ping if you see anything else.

cj (Eng): minor nit — change table header 'budgeted_rate' -> 'budgeted_rate_per_min' to make unit explicit. saves support tickets later.

karina (Docs): done — changed header and added unit note. thanks.

michael (Pricing): approved :thumbsup:

oliver (SDK): tests fixed and merged. CI green.

karina (Docs): merging after CI passes. thanks y'all! :tada:
